# HOLIX Magazine

> A digital library of original magazine issues, read online for free.

HOLIX Magazine publishes its own original magazine issues as PDFs, readable directly in the browser. Visitors register with just a name (no password) to read and comment on issues. Content is Holix's own original publication, not user-submitted.

## Legal
- Terms of Service: /terms.html
- Privacy Policy: /privacy.html

## Stack
Node/Express server, static HTML/CSS/JS frontend, Supabase (database), pdf.js for in-browser PDF rendering.

## Links
- Live site: https://holix-magazine.onrender.com/
